item.malstone.weeping_power: It can be charged using the Well of Crying
item.malstone.skill_use.text: There is also %d%% recharge time for this item
item.malstone.white_arrow: This item is affected by the Arcane Resonance attribute, and the lower the stat, the better the effect of this item
attribute.name.malstone.tough_blood.desc: Gain the same amount of health that is not affected by the bonus
attribute.name.malstone.chaos_erosion.de: Healing has a chance to restore Soul Ward, but doing so cancels the healing instance.
Converts a portion of armor into a fixed, unaffected value (only directly added armor is considered).
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.huge_soul: The Pewter Monolith stands in opposition to spellcraft. It embodies unyielding power. When worn... it lingers unseen, dragging the cursed armor of darkness back into reality...
item.malstone.huge_soul.text.3: Wearing Malignant Stronghold armor grants additional Aegis of Malice
item.malstone.huge_soul.text.4: Converts a portion of armor into a fixed, unaffected value
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.white_arr: The Pewter Blade Necklace reigns above the scythe itself. Its power is enough to twist any existing matter. When worn... no matter where you stand, it rends space and sorcery into scattered fragments...
item.malstone.white_arrow_blade.text.3: Your scythe always performs sweeping attacks
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.breaking_: Unlike any known substance, the Life-Severing Blade releases a force that makes space and living beings tremble. The wielder’s vitality is restrained... in exchange for what is called absolute supremacy.
item.malstone.breaking_the_life.text.1: Losing health grants massive attribute bonuses
item.malstone.breaking_the_life.text.2: Health can only regenerate up to %d%%
item.malstone.breaking_the_life.text.3: Hunger stops draining once health reaches %d%%
malum.gui.book.entry.eternal_fallen_soul: Rune of the Eternal Fallen Soul
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.eternal_f: The Rune of the Eternal Fallen Soul merges the power of nothingness from the other side. Let the holder receive an additional blessing from the law of another plane when healing the soul, although it is not permanent, but it is enough....
item.malstone.eternal_fallen_soul.text: Restoring a Soul Shield will temporarily stack some of your attributes
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.blade_dat: The Blade Oath Rune makes the wielder's scythe proficiency invisible, and while wielding the scythe to deal damage, it also gains a great ability to absorb souls, so that the bearer's life force is continuous and endless, but this effect only exists when the scythe is used... Even if you use the scythe, you can still feel extremely tired
item.malstone.blade_dath.text: Using a scythe-type weapon will deal 2nd stage instantaneous damage
item.malstone.blade_dath.text.1: Greatly increases the sweeping attack range of scythe-type weapons
item.malstone.blade_dath.text.2: Damage dealt by non-scythe weapons reduced to 5%
item.malstone.blade_dath.text.3: Physical damage dealt by the scythe allows you to quickly perform the next attack without being protected by the invincibility frame
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.martyrdom: The Rune of the Martyr needs to be used with the Blade Oath Rune to achieve the best condition
item.malstone.martyrdom.text: The damage dealt by a light hit is %d%% of the damage dealt by the last full force
item.malstone.martyrdom.text.1: The number of times this rune is given may be doubled
The hunger rune is a symbol of greed and a partner in killing, allowing the wielder to feed the war while harvesting the souls of others
item.malstone.hungrier.text: Restore hunger and saturation when picking up spirits
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.soul_devi: The soul device can double the number of souls harvested, of course, this is probability, about 50%
item.malstone.soul_device.text.1: Picking up spirits has a chance to double the number
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.ring_of_a: After incorporating the Twisted Arcane energy from the Well of Weeping into the Evil Thought Pewter, this ring was born that allows the user to better control the Evil Thought Pewter item.
佩戴这枚戒指后， 原本沉重并难以挥动的 白镴之镰与白镴之斧 将随着你的杀戮变得 越发轻盈。侵蚀权杖中的虚空物质 也变得越发活跃， 开始催动出更加复杂的 能量束侵蚀他人的肉体， 若是这种侵蚀遭到阻挡 则其将转变为， 更加强大的魔法 攻击袭向对方！
malum.gui.book.entry.falling_well.descri: The first appearance of spatial fluctuations
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.falling_w: The well is staring at you, you feel a qualitative mutation in your body, and.... Your second heart, an evil heart
item.malstone.falling_well.text.1: The Rotten Heart Shield can absorb some of the damage like a soul shield
item.malstone.falling_well.text.2: The reduction of the Decay Heart Shield will bring a stat bonus
item.malstone.falling_well.text.3: This item can be charged using the Well of Crying
item.malstone.falling_well.text.4: Reduces the maximum health and damage reduction of nearby creatures while active
item.malstone.falling_well.text.5: Falling from a well while active will more effectively restore the Rotten Heart Shield and increase its strength
item.malstone.falling_well.text.6: There is also %d%% recharge time for falling into the well
malum.gui.book.entry.condenser.descripti: The first appearance of spatial fluctuations
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.condenser: The instantaneous condenser can cause a spatial fluctuation in a short period of time, the number of such fluctuations is unlimited, and each time a spatial fluctuation is caused, it will instantly teleport nearby spirits to the target location
item.malstone.condenser.text.1: The spirit generated by the creature can reach your location instantly
malum.gui.book.entry.evil_engine.descrip: the first appearance of spatial fluctuations
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.evil_engi: The Evil Engine is a 3-in-1 mode that greatly reduces the consumption of slots, greatly increases the speed of experience gained and increases the health restored in some cases, and the saturation of its recovery is enhanced compared to the Rune of Greed
item.malstone.evil_engine.text.1: The harvested spirits will be destroyed
item.malstone.evil_engine.text.2: Each time you destroy a spirit, you will regain life
item.malstone.evil_engine.text.3: Restore hunger and saturation if no treatment is required
item.malstone.evil_engine.text.4: Gain experience points if you don't need to eat
item.malstone.extremely_dead.text.1: Natural Spirits deal damage to passing creatures while flying, while weakening the target
item.malstone.extremely_dead.text.2: Natural Spirits can no longer be picked up and briefly increases their magic damage upon contact
item.malstone.extremely_dead.text.3: If strengthened by the Well of Crying, it may spawn a Shadow Spirit when killing the target
item.malstone.extremely_dead.text.4: Gain a large number of Spirit Plunder levels in the enhanced state
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.weeping_i: 泣仙又被称为堕落之仙， 似乎是来自哭泣之井的未知存在 所凝聚而成的产物， 这是我发现的事实......
我发现 在跳入哭泣之井后部分的属性，也就是物理伤害，攻速，移速， 魔法伤害，魔法抗性会获得大幅提高。
但是我也可以使用 幽影精魂来为此物充能， 就像使用收纳袋一样使用它
item.malstone.weeping_immortal.text.4: The loss of the Arcane Harmony attribute will remove the bonus of this item
item.malstone.weeping_immortal.text.1: Jumping into the Well of Weeping will briefly gain a large stat bonus
item.malstone.weeping_immortal.text.2: The effect of jumping into the Well of Weeping can be achieved by giving the Weeping Shadow Spirit
item.malstone.weeping_immortal.text.3: Or pick up the Shadow Spirit to achieve a similar effect, but the enhancement time will be reduced
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.breaking_: The coercion of the Extreme Blade can lock on to creatures within an effective range, but this coercion cannot cause critical damage
item.malstone.breaking_the_weapon.text.1: Even if your attack crosshair is offset from target
item.malstone.breaking_the_weapon.text.2: But the target can still be attacked within a reasonable offset
item.malstone.breaking_the_weapon.text.3: Attacks that perform corrections are almost impossible to critically hit
item.malstone.breaking_the_weapon.text.4: Deals additional piercing damage to targets with armor or soul shields
item.malstone.breaking_the_weapon.text.6: Increased damage dealt to creatures with full health
item.malstone.corpse_cauldron.text.1: The food eaten will be digested twice, during which hunger, saturation, and health will slowly recover
item.malstone.corpse_cauldron.text.2: The tenacity blood attribute that is rewarded by eating different foods
item.malstone.corpse_cauldron.text.3: If charged by the well of weeping:
item.malstone.corpse_cauldron.text.4: Increases physical and magical resistance by 15% and an additional 20% of the Blood of Fortitude attribute
item.malstone.corpse_cauldron.text.5: Greatly increase the speed of eating and digestion
item.malstone.wallow_axe.text.2: Critical hits will definitely trigger the Soul Harvesting effect
item.malstone.die_abyss.text.1: Reduces the energy cost of warped items by 80%
item.malstone.die_abyss.text.2: Killing a creature can recharge all warped items
item.malstone.kill_the_gods.text.1: Hit a creature will produce essence blood
item.malstone.kill_the_gods.text.2: Pick up blood to get a blood shield
item.malstone.kill_the_gods.text.3: Press the 'bind key' to destroy the blood shield to restore health and increase stats
item.malstone.kill_the_gods.text.4: However, there will be a certain cooldown, during which you will not be able to harvest essence
item.malstone.ring_of_authority.text.1: For the Soul Saving Scythe and the Cosmic Axe:
item.malstone.ring_of_authority.text.2: Attack speed increases gradually when dealing damage
item.malstone.ring_of_authority.text.3: Inflicting a large number of negative states on the target when using the Erosion Scepter to fire an erosion energy beam
item.malstone.ring_of_authority.text.4: if the target is immune to negative effects
item.malstone.ring_of_authority.text.5: Each state immune increases the damage of the erosion beam by 20%
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.soul_stee: The Soulsteel component is a failed item. But it seems to have life. The holder's healing will be limited... But every treatment has the potential to heal your soul, but at the cost of making the original vitality disappear without a trace.
